_meta.tiers: ideal > good > fair > poor > dangerous (fair/poor = concerning). Values are [min,max], null = unbounded.

source_tags.regulatory: WAC 173-201A (Mar 2025), EPA criteria, Carlson 1996, WHO 2003 as fetched
source_tags.literature: published study values (USGS 2010, Richter & Kolmes 2005, Auburn) as fetched
source_tags.recalled: published values I recalled but could not open this session (Dodds 1998, EPA 1986 Gold Book TP, Nurnberg TN)
source_tags.estimated: my interpolation, show as estimated in UI

_meta.ponds: use lake bands (no pond standards exist); streams and rivers share bands

lake_pond.note: <=4 ultra-oligotrophic (WAC); 4-10 oligo; 10-20 lower meso; 20-35 upper meso (Columbia Basin); >96 Carlson hypereutrophic

stream_river.note: 10 = EPA Eco II rivers; 25 = Dodds oligo/meso (recalled); 42-129 = USGS biological breakpoint; 100 = EPA 1986 (recalled)

lake_pond.note: EPA Eco II ref 100-410; Nurnberg bands 350/650/1200 (recalled)

stream_river.note: Dodds 700/1500 (recalled); USGS breakpoint 2400-3300; EPA Eco II ref 120

lake_pond.note: Carlson 2.6/7.3; WHO: 10 (low probability of cyanobacteria health effects) and 50 (moderate)

stream_river_seston.note: 4.5-7.5 = USGS seston breakpoint; EPA Eco II ref 1.08

stream_river_benthic_mg_m2.note: 54-68 = USGS periphyton breakpoint; 20 Dodds (recalled). Different unit (mg/m2), so it is not used for scoring

lake_pond.note: Carlson table; EPA Eco II ref 4.5, Puget Lowlands 3.5

secchi_depth_m.stream_note: Use turbidity instead: WAC <=5 NTU over background (strict salmonid uses), 10 NTU (rearing/migration only); EPA Eco II ref 1.3 NTU

stream_river_salmonid.note: WAC 7-DADMax 12 char/16 core/17.5/18 redband/20 warm; feeding drops near 22; death in hours 24-26; >26 lethal; >27-30 minutes

pond_warmwater.note: only 20 is a WAC value (warm-water species)

water_temperature_C.too_cold: No WA minimum; <4 slows metabolism; ice cover risks oxygen depletion

coldwater.note: WAC 10 mg/L or 90% sat (salmonid uses), 6.5 (rearing/migration, warm water); EPA 1986 coldwater: 30-d mean 6.5, 7-d mean ELS 9.5, 1-d min 4.0 (8.0 ELS)

warmwater.note: EPA 1986 warmwater: 30-d mean 5.5, 7-d mean ELS 6.0, 1-d min 3.0 (5.0 ELS)

supersaturation_pct.note: WAC total dissolved gas limit 110%; gas bubble trauma risk above that; wide daily swings signal algae

all.source: regulatory 6.5-8.5 (WAC); EPA 6.5-9.0; Auburn: acid death <4, alkaline >10-11
all.rate_of_change: sudden change of 1.5+ units can kill ~half of fish; WAC caps human-caused change at 0.2 (char/core summer) or 0.5 units
